title: I just moved to Ireland
blurb: The first things to sort out, in a sensible order.

title: We are having a baby
blurb: Leave, payments and paperwork, before and after the birth.

title: I am starting a job
blurb: Get paid correctly from the first payslip and know your rights.

title: I lost my job
blurb: Income first, then what you are owed.

title: I am renting or buying a home
blurb: Your rights as a tenant, help with rent and help to buy.

title: I want to drive
blurb: From the theory test to the NCT.

title: I want to become Irish
blurb: Citizenship by residence or through family, then the passport.

title: I am getting older
blurb: Pension, free travel and help with bills and care.

title: Someone has died
blurb: What has to be done, and when.

title: I am sick or caring for someone
blurb: Income while you cannot work, and help with health costs.
